basic_details.job_title: NIT Goa Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Civil Engineering at National Institute of Technology Goa is filling one Junior Research Fellow post on the NTTM-sanctioned project "Development and Performance Evaluation of a Hybrid Geo-Composite Element for Construction of Pavements on Weak Subgrade Soils", funded through the National Technical Textile Mission, Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India. The pay is Rs. 37,000 per month + 20% HRA, and the post needs B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in Civil Engineering with GATE. Apply through the Google Form by 01.12.2026.

rows.details: Development and Performance Evaluation of a Hybrid Geo-Composite Element for Construction of Pavements on Weak Subgrade Soils (Project Order no. 1/16/2025-NTTM(12thMSG)/13)
National Technical Textile Mission (NTTM), Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India
Project duration 33 months; position offered for 1 year initially
Rs. 37,000 per month + 20% HRA with other allowances as per the Institute norms
National Institute of Technology Goa, Cuncolim, South Goa District, Goa

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Goa is located at Cuncolim, South Goa District, Goa. The Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. Harikumar M, Assistant Professor, Department of Civil Engineering. The notice lists these project objectives: Development of a novel hybrid geosynthetic system comprising coir geotextile and synthetic geogrid layers. Characterization and comparative evaluation of the developed hybrid geosynthetic. Assessment of the performance of hybrid geosynthetics in weak pavement subgrades under static and cyclic loading conditions. Development of an Artificial Neural Network based prediction model for effective field implementation of hybrid geosynthetic systems. Validation of laboratory findings through field-scale pavement test sections and correlation of laboratory and field performance behaviour.

rows.pay: Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA with other allowances as per the Institute norms

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the JRF post is B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in the relevant specialization of Civil Engineering with GATE qualification obtained at some point in time. The candidate needs at least 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale grading system or 60% marks in aggregate from a recognized technical institute or university in a full-time program. For SC/ST candidates, the minimum is 6.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale grading system or 55% marks, with GATE qualification obtained at some point in time. Strong knowledge of Geotechnical Engineering, Pavement Engineering and Geosynthetics. Experience in laboratory testing of soils, geotextiles, geogrids and pavement materials. Exposure to Artificial Neural Networks, Machine Learning or predictive modelling techniques is desirable. Proficiency in software/tools such as MATLAB, Python, PLAXIS, ABAQUS, GeoStudio or similar engineering analysis software will be preferred. Ability to conduct field investigations, instrumentation and monitoring of pavement test sections. Good technical writing, research publication and communication skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly salary is Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA, with other allowances as per the Institute norms. The position will be offered for 1 year initially, which can be further extended based on the performance review. After 2 years, the JRF position will be converted into SRF based on the performance review. The applicant may get a chance to enroll into the PhD program at NIT Goa, as per the Institute norms. The appointment is for a time bound project, and the selected candidate must join immediately. All terms and conditions are as per the guidelines of NTTM, Ministry of Textiles, GoI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Goa JRF-Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Fill the application form in the format printed in the notice (Post Applied for: Junior Research Fellow; Project Order No: 1/16/2025-NTTM(12thMSG)/13). Paste a recent passport size photograph on the form. Submit the form with the latest updated CV, and self-attested copies of certificates, supporting documents and experience in soft copy, at the Google Form link https://forms.gle/T5XuYwfD7AXeXGKz8 by 01.12.2026. The form asks for personal details, GATE score, rank, specialization and year, academic qualification from Standard 10 onwards, research experience, publications, address for communication, contact details of two referees, areas of expertise and experience details. The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and photographs submitted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and need of the project; having the prescribed qualification does not ensure a call for interview. Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail, apart from the NIT Goa website www.nitgoa.ac.in , with the date and time of the written test and/or interview. No other letter is sent to the correspondence address. Shortlisted candidates must present themselves with the updated CV, the application form, and original and attested photocopies of marksheets/certificates in support of academic qualifications. Applicants in employment (private, government or any other organization) must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is paid to candidates for attending the interview and/or joining the position. Incomplete application forms and forms received after the due date will be summarily rejected. For queries, contact Dr. Harikumar M, Assistant Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, National Institute of Technology Goa, Cuncolim, Salcete- 403703, Goa, India; phone 0832 2595297; e-mail [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there at NIT Goa?
faq.answer: There is 1 JRF-Junior Research Fellow vacancy in the Department of Civil Engineering under the NTTM project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Goa JRF post?
faq.answer: The application form must be submitted at the Google Form link by 01.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Goa JRF post?
faq.answer: B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in the relevant specialization of Civil Engineering with GATE qualification, and at least 6.5 CGPA or 60% marks in aggregate. SC/ST candidates need 6.0 CGPA or 55% marks, with GATE.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NIT Goa JRF?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000 per month + 20% HRA, with other allowances as per the Institute norms.

faq.question: Q5. Are HRA and allowances paid on top of Rs. 37,000?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA with other allowances as per the Institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Goa JRF post?
faq.answer: Submit the application form with the updated CV and self-attested copies of certificates, supporting documents and experience in soft copy at the Google Form link given in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and need of the project, then called for a written test and/or interview, with the details sent by e-mail.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Goa JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is for a time bound project. The position is offered for 1 year initially, can be extended based on performance review, and the project duration is 33 months.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is paid for attending the interview and/or joining the position.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview.
